title: Knewzly anchor set
description: Documented contract for content/anchors.json. Reference only — validated by hand-written checks in test/content-schema.test.js, not by a schema-validation library (zero new dependencies, per F01 design.md TD-001).

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier. Referenced by relationships.json and today-stories.json.

sortKey.description: A single sortable year for chronological placement.

themes.description: Optional theme-filter tags (FR-014, Could Have — not rendered by any task in this pass, but content may carry them for later use).

claimType.description: Matches F01 requirements.md FR-011's exact three-type vocabulary. Note: PLAN.md's project-wide Source and Provenance Baseline was later extended to four types (adding 'hypothesis') for F08/Archie's dynamic Q&A use case, but F01's own approved requirements.md was not amended to match — this schema deliberately follows F01's actual approved contract, not the newer four-type list, since anchors describe established history rather than open speculative questions. Flag to Henry if this divergence should be reconciled.
